page_title: BOU 2-3 ARS | Bournemouth v Arsenal 03/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) works the corner short.

90+2' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the bottom right corner. It's a great effort but an even better save from Djordje Petrovic, who tips the ball around the post.
90+1' Yellow card. Amine Adli (Bournemouth) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) has a crack at goal from the edge of the box, but it drifts high over the bar to safety.
88' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
87' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
85' Declan Rice (Arsenal) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
80' A substitution has been made. Martin Odegaard goes off and Mikel Merino (Arsenal) comes on.
80' Eli Junior Kroupi (Bournemouth) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
79' The linesman makes the right call and Bournemouth will have a corner.

76' 2 - 3 Nice piece of skill by Eli Junior Kroupi (Bournemouth). He perfectly collected a pass from Lewis Cook, then unleashed a fantastic long-range strike which went inside the left post. The score is 2:3.
76' Bournemouth will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
74' The referee allows time for a substitution. Alex Scott will be replaced by Eli Junior Kroupi (Bournemouth).
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Justin Kluivert leaves the pitch and Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) comes on.
74' Andoni Iraola has decided to make a change. Enes Unal (Bournemouth) replaces Evanilson.
71' 1 - 3 Goal! Bukayo Saka provides Declan Rice (Arsenal) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the bottom right corner. 1:3.
70' Martin Zubimendi (Arsenal) infringed the rules and goes into the book. Chris Kavanagh pulls out a yellow card.
67' Today's match ends for David Brooks who will be replaced by Amine Adli (Bournemouth).
67' Mikel Arteta prepares a substitution. Noni Madueke is replaced by Bukayo Saka (Arsenal).
67' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) comes onto the pitch so that Gabriel Martinelli can be given a rest.
66' Here is a change. Viktor Gyökeres is going off and Mikel Arteta gives the last tactical orders to Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal).
64' Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) picks up a long through ball, but Djordje Petrovic deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
62' Noni Madueke (Arsenal) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
60' The ball goes out of play. Arsenal are awarded a corner kick.
59' It's a nice effort by Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of David Raya. Easy save.
59' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

58' David Brooks (Bournemouth) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds David Brooks (Bournemouth) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Bournemouth.
56' The corner from Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) is cleared away by the defence.

54' 1 - 2 Goal! Great link up play between Declan Rice (Arsenal) and Martin Odegaard gives the former a clear sight of goal on the edge of the box. He doesn't disappoint and beats the keeper in the bottom right corner. 1:2.

53' David Brooks (Bournemouth) weaves through the defence with ease and gets into a good position in front of goal. He pulls the trigger in an effort to beat the keeper, but fails as the ball zooms around the right post.
53' William Saliba (Arsenal) makes a rough challenge and Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle for a foul.
51' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Arsenal.
50' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' Chris Kavanagh has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Martin Odegaard.
43' The current number of shots on goal is 1:1.
40' Piero Hincapie (Arsenal) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
38' Some great controlled play and passing from Arsenal. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
35' Bournemouth fail to score from a corner as David Raya (Arsenal) leaps to collect the ball.
34' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) takes the corner.
31' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and immediately unleashes a shot towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar.

29' Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.
26' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
25' Bournemouth win a direct free kick in a dangerous mid-range position.
23' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes miles wide of the left post.
22' Evanilson (Bournemouth) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
18' Declan Rice (Arsenal) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
16' 1 - 1 Goal! Gabriel (Arsenal) fires the rebound inside the left post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:1.
16' Declan Rice (Arsenal) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
14' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the right post.
13' A long-range free kick is awarded to Bournemouth.
10' 1 - 0 Goal! Some very poor defending from the opponent allows Evanilson (Bournemouth) the chance to get to the edge of the box and he makes no mistake with a lovely finish. It's 1:0.
8' Noni Madueke (Arsenal) amazingly found his way through the defence, but lacked a precise finish as his effort from close range went slightly over the crossbar.
6' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
3' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
2' Now Bournemouth have a corner.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Bournemouth will have the kick-off.
Chris Kavanagh is introduced as the referee for today's match.
